validation: Executable compiled Workshop is identical after reversing global names and excluding declaration order and action comments; player fields/scopes are preserved.

variables.name: tmp0
variables.comment: Synchronous scratch: number, position, player or list; assign before use and do not retain across waits.

variables.name: tmp1
variables.comment: Second simultaneously live scratch value; may hold a scalar, player, vector or list.

variables.name: tmp2
variables.comment: Third simultaneously live scratch value; may hold a scalar, player, vector or list.

variables.name: offsetUpThreeQuartersConst
variables.comment: Vertical offset of 0.75 m for labels, icons and visibility checks.

variables.name: offsetUpHalfConst
variables.comment: Vertical offset of 0.5 m for labels and effects.

variables.name: losOffsetConst
variables.comment: Vertical offset of 1.2 m used by line-of-sight checks.

variables.name: colorChargeBatteryConst
variables.comment: Shared Charge Battery color used by the menu and enhancement visuals.

variables.name: dummyHoldingPositionConst
variables.comment: Off-map holding position for newly created or reconfigured dummy bots.

variables.name: colorKevlarConst
variables.comment: Shared Kevlar color used by the menu and enhancement visuals.

variables.name: isPregameSetup
variables.comment: Pregame hero selection/voting is active; cleared by START GAME before gameplay activation.

variables.name: isSpecialGameMode
variables.comment: TDM, CTF, PUSH or CONTROL uses alternate menu/spawn handling.

variables.name: isGameplayActive
variables.comment: Objectives are generated and combat is active; cleared when the match outcome is decided.

variables.name: isOvertimeActive
variables.comment: Prevents repeated overtime activation and zombie relocation on standard modes.

variables.name: isVoting
variables.comment: Global pregame vote is open; separate from each player's isVoting field.

variables.name: difficultySetting
variables.comment: Cached player-count difficulty used to select zombie stats and scaling.

variables.name: challengeSetting
variables.comment: Selected Challenge option, retained after pregame voting.

variables.name: zombieSetting
variables.comment: Selected zombie roster/spawn-rate mode, retained after pregame voting.

variables.name: objectiveTypeSetting
variables.comment: Selected objective mode or Mixed setting; differs from the current objective type.

variables.name: matchEndTime
variables.comment: Native-gamemode timer offset: zero or 0.1, used as the match-time floor.

variables.name: uniqueSkinCap
variables.comment: Configured maximum number of different hero skins shared by players and zombies.

variables.name: numberOfBots
variables.comment: Configured zombie population target, including queued replacements.

variables.name: startPos
variables.comment: Center/aim position of the pregame hero-selection scene.

variables.name: startCamPos
variables.comment: Pregame camera position used to place players and world text.

variables.name: startMenuSpacingAngle
variables.comment: Hero-scene spacing angle; zero also means menu initialization is not finished.

variables.name: startMenuZombieColorList
variables.comment: Pregame Zombie Mode HUD colors indexed by option ID.

variables.name: startMenuObjectiveColorList
variables.comment: Pregame Objective Type HUD colors indexed by raw objective ID.

variables.name: startMenuEnhancementColorList
variables.comment: Pregame Enhancement HUD colors indexed by enhancement ID.

variables.name: challengeVoteList
variables.comment: Challenge availability/count entries, indexed by vote option.

variables.name: zombieVoteList
variables.comment: Zombie-mode availability/count entries, indexed by vote option.

variables.name: objectiveTypeVoteList
variables.comment: Objective-type availability/count entries, indexed by raw objective ID.

variables.name: enhancementOptionList
variables.comment: Enhancement icons/availability used by pregame selection and world text.

variables.name: pregameGlitchText
variables.comment: Random distorted Challenge text shown during the pregame flashing effect.

variables.name: isPregameGlitchActive
variables.comment: Enables the pregame Challenge text/color flash.

variables.name: walkCenter
variables.comment: Walkable map center used for grid generation, the menu and player teleportation.

variables.name: mapGridList
variables.comment: Cached walkable map positions used by objectives, teleports, supplies and the finale.

variables.name: attackSpawnRooms
variables.comment: Standard modes: list of spawn-room positions; the unused CTF fallback stores one position.

variables.name: activeAttackSpawnRoom
variables.comment: Currently activated spawn-room position; may differ from the room being tested.

variables.name: spawnRoomIndex
variables.comment: Room index during pregame recording/rotation and in-match safe-room selection.

variables.name: botSpawnPointList
variables.comment: Cached successful zombie spawn/teleport positions.

variables.name: botSpawnPointTimerList
variables.comment: Per-spawn-point cooldown/load values, indexed with botSpawnPointList.

variables.name: botSpawnWaypointList
variables.comment: Movement waypoint associated with each cached botSpawnPointList entry.

variables.name: customTeleportPositionList
variables.comment: Special teleport positions transferred from dying bots to replacement bots.

variables.name: botSpawnTimeList
variables.comment: Remaining delays for queued zombie replacements, decremented once per second.

variables.name: objectivePositionList
variables.comment: Queued objective positions; index zero is current, the final entry is extraction.
variables.group: Shared objective generation and runtime state

variables.name: objectiveTypeList
variables.comment: Queued objective types aligned with objectivePositionList.
variables.group: Shared objective generation and runtime state

variables.name: objectiveSpacingList
variables.comment: Consecutive/minimum placement distances calculated from the map-grid size.
variables.group: Shared objective generation and runtime state

variables.name: mixedObjectiveTypeList
variables.comment: Allowed Mixed objective types used while building the mission queue.
variables.group: Shared objective generation and runtime state

variables.name: objectiveValue
variables.comment: Current type snapshot published when global objective visuals are refreshed.
variables.group: Shared objective generation and runtime state

variables.name: objectiveCaptureValue
variables.comment: Numeric progress/kill score, or a list of three terminal percentages in Satellite Uplink.
variables.group: Shared objective generation and runtime state

variables.name: objectiveRad
variables.comment: Current objective radius; also chased or temporarily expanded by some objective types.
variables.group: Shared objective generation and runtime state

variables.name: objectiveDescription
variables.comment: Current task description displayed by the global match HUD.
variables.group: Shared objective generation and runtime state

variables.name: objectiveColor
variables.comment: Shared objective visual color, including Showdown progress-loss flashes.
variables.group: Shared objective generation and runtime state

variables.name: isObjectiveComplete
variables.comment: Requests objective advancement and coordinates objective/player recovery rules.
variables.group: Shared objective generation and runtime state

variables.name: objectivePlayerList
variables.comment: Players currently capturing, repairing, depositing resources or extracting.
variables.group: Shared objective generation and runtime state

variables.name: objectiveEntityIdList
variables.comment: Global objective effect/text/icon/progress-bar IDs retained for cleanup.
variables.group: Shared objective generation and runtime state

variables.name: objectiveEntitiesCount
variables.comment: Index of the yielding global objective-visual cleanup loop.
variables.group: Shared objective generation and runtime state

variables.name: objectiveResourcePositionList
variables.comment: Dropped-resource positions in Biomorphing or terminal positions in Satellite Uplink.
variables.group: Shared objective generation and runtime state

variables.name: testPos
variables.comment: Candidate position retained across waits during mission placement or survivor spawning.
variables.group: Shared objective generation and runtime state

variables.name: testPos2
variables.comment: Minimum survivor-spawn distance or minimum spacing between satellite terminals.
variables.group: Shared objective generation and runtime state

variables.name: objectiveCount1
variables.comment: Mission-placement attempt count, then remaining satellite firing-loop steps.
variables.group: Shared objective generation and runtime state

variables.name: objectiveChase1
variables.comment: Saved Rescue radius (number), Kill Zone center (vector), or Satellite laser position (vector).
variables.group: Shared objective generation and runtime state

variables.name: goalPost
variables.comment: Next 25-percent progress checkpoint shared by Showdown and Biomorphing.
variables.group: Shared objective generation and runtime state

variables.name: queuedGoalList
variables.comment: Showdown: contesting zombies; Biomorphing: queued resource-goal IDs.
variables.group: Shared objective generation and runtime state

variables.name: survivorToRescue
variables.comment: Rescue NPC or current zombie target followed by the Satellite laser.
variables.group: Shared objective generation and runtime state

variables.name: playerTargetList
variables.comment: Active zombie targets; can temporarily include the NPC being rescued.
variables.group: Player roster, reconnect state and revival

variables.name: userNameList
variables.comment: Recorded player names used to restore state when a user rejoins.
variables.group: Player roster, reconnect state and revival

variables.name: playerStatsList
variables.comment: Per-user death status, timers and last position, indexed with userNameList.
variables.group: Player roster, reconnect state and revival

variables.name: healthpackPositionList
variables.comment: Discovered health-pack positions used by infection-cure indicators.
variables.group: Player roster, reconnect state and revival

variables.name: mustReviveTime
variables.comment: Allowed rescue time; starts at 60 and decreases after permanent player deaths.
variables.group: Player roster, reconnect state and revival

variables.name: botHeroList
variables.comment: Zombie hero order used to index spawn weights and all per-hero stat tables.
variables.group: Shared zombie stats, mutations and boss state

variables.name: botSpawnRateList
variables.comment: Per-hero spawn weights; Zombie Shuffle can reorder them during gameplay.
variables.group: Shared zombie stats, mutations and boss state

variables.name: botBiteDamageList
variables.comment: Per-hero bite damage selected for the current difficulty.
variables.group: Shared zombie stats, mutations and boss state

variables.name: botBiteDurationList
variables.comment: Per-hero bite damage-over-time durations selected for the current difficulty.
variables.group: Shared zombie stats, mutations and boss state

variables.name: botDamageDealtList
variables.comment: Per-hero damage percentages, also used to calibrate bite damage.
variables.group: Shared zombie stats, mutations and boss state

variables.name: botHealthList
variables.comment: Per-hero maximum health values selected for the current difficulty.
variables.group: Shared zombie stats, mutations and boss state

variables.name: botThrottleSpeedList
variables.comment: Per-hero movement throttle values selected for the current difficulty.
variables.group: Shared zombie stats, mutations and boss state

variables.name: availableMutationList
variables.comment: Enabled mutation IDs configured through Workshop settings.
variables.group: Shared zombie stats, mutations and boss state

variables.name: miniBossList
variables.comment: Current miniboss membership, independent of the large objective boss/egg.
variables.group: Shared zombie stats, mutations and boss state

variables.name: bossStateList
variables.comment: Shared Bosses/Zombie Egg state: boss player at index 0, head-height measurement at index 1.
variables.group: Shared zombie stats, mutations and boss state

variables.name: isSmolderEventActive
variables.comment: Global Winston/Smolder phase affecting spawns, abilities, effects and player HUD.
variables.group: Shared zombie stats, mutations and boss state

variables.name: bossesAvailableHeroList
variables.comment: Bosses-only hero rotation; retained between Bosses objectives until the pool is exhausted.

variables.name: bossesExcludedHeroList
variables.comment: Hero types excluded from the Bosses objective hero pool when enough alternatives exist.

variables.name: biomorphingQueuedTypeList
variables.comment: Shuffled resource types 0/1/2 assigned to successive zombie resource carriers.
variables.group: Biomorphing objective: goals, resources and deferred drops

variables.name: biomorphingGoalText
variables.comment: Current requested-material/blood message displayed by the Biomorphing HUD.
variables.group: Biomorphing objective: goals, resources and deferred drops

variables.name: biomorphingGoalColor
variables.comment: Current Biomorphing goal color used by its HUD and announcements.
variables.group: Biomorphing objective: goals, resources and deferred drops

variables.name: isBiomorphingGoalPending
variables.comment: Requests Biomorphing resource cleanup and initialization of the next resource goal.
variables.group: Biomorphing objective: goals, resources and deferred drops

variables.name: biomorphingResourceTypeList
variables.comment: Types of dropped resources, indexed with the shared resource-position list.
variables.group: Biomorphing objective: goals, resources and deferred drops

variables.name: biomorphingDeferredTypeList
variables.comment: Queued resource types awaiting orb creation after their holders die.
variables.group: Biomorphing objective: goals, resources and deferred drops

variables.name: biomorphingDeferredPositionList
variables.comment: World positions aligned with biomorphingDeferredTypeList.
variables.group: Biomorphing objective: goals, resources and deferred drops

variables.name: biomorphingResourceTextIdList
variables.comment: World-text IDs for dropped resources, retained until pickup or goal cleanup.
variables.group: Biomorphing objective: goals, resources and deferred drops

variables.name: biomorphingResourceEffectIdList
variables.comment: Effect IDs for dropped resource orbs, retained until pickup or goal cleanup.
variables.group: Biomorphing objective: goals, resources and deferred drops

variables.name: biomorphingCleanupIndex
variables.comment: Index retained across waits while old resource effects and labels are destroyed.
variables.group: Biomorphing objective: goals, resources and deferred drops

variables.name: biomorphingResourceColorList
variables.comment: Colors indexed by resource type, including the blood goal.
variables.group: Biomorphing objective: goals, resources and deferred drops

variables.name: biomorphingResourceNameList
variables.comment: Resource names indexed by ordinary resource type: head, arm and leg.
variables.group: Biomorphing objective: goals, resources and deferred drops

variables.name: extractionZoneRad
variables.comment: Shrinking extraction-dome radius; initialized to 300 and also checked by defeat rules.

variables.name: extractionSpeedUp
variables.comment: Dome shrink speed, initially 2.5 and increased by players at extraction.

variables.name: extractionFlightSpeed
variables.comment: Successful extraction flight-stage speed, switched between 2, 10 and 50.

variables.name: extractionFlightDestination
variables.comment: Random shared destination used by the successful extraction flight.

variables.name: evacSurvivorList
variables.comment: Snapshot of extracted players, also used to exclude survivors from finale kills.

variables.name: evacCount
variables.comment: Counter for 400 finale explosions, used on both victory and defeat.

variables.name: chase1
variables.comment: Pregame hidden timer (number), then the finale projectile position (vector).

variables.name: supplyDropLandingPosition
variables.comment: Target ground position where the current supply drop will land.

variables.name: supplyDropPosition
variables.comment: Current supply-drop position, animated while it falls.

variables.name: isSupplyDropOpen
variables.comment: Drop is open, or no drop has spawned yet; allows generation of the next drop.

variables.name: supplyDropPowerUpCount
variables.comment: Configured number of power-ups spawned when a supply drop is opened.

variables.name: supplyPowerUpIdList
variables.comment: Item type IDs of ground power-ups from supplies, player drops and Biomorphing rewards.

variables.name: supplyPowerUpPositionList
variables.comment: Ground power-up positions indexed by the same item list.

variables.name: supplyPowerUpTextIdList
variables.comment: World-text IDs for removing item labels on pickup or exchange.

variables.name: supplyPowerUpEffectIdList
variables.comment: Effect IDs for removing item orbs on pickup or exchange.

variables.name: numbersList
variables.comment: Shared compressed numeric lookup data for stat tables, spawn weights and menu vote IDs.

variables.name: debugHud
variables.comment: ID of the host diagnostics HUD, recreated after phase cleanup.
